snippet.title: City Bus Manager | Console Edition | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT ON PS4, PS5, XBOX ONE AND XBOX SERIES X|S ON 15th MAY 2025 
-----
Build your own bus depot from scratch and create your personal bus routes in City Bus Manager. Play in your own hometown or any famous city in the world with real map data. Buy buses, maintain them, take care of your staff and lead your bus company to become the #1 in town!
PLAYSTATION: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012913
XBOX:  https://www.xbox.com/de-de/games/store/city-bus-manager/9pf5tpm8ff9h
